'''Dave Kaptain''' is an American chemist and politician who is the current [[mayor]] of [[Elgin, Illinois|Elgin]], [[Illinois]].<ref name="KaptainOusts">{{cite news |last=Jenco |first=Melissa |date=April 5, 2011 |url=http://triblocal.com/elgin/2011/04/05/kaptain-ousts-schock-as-mayor/ |title=Kaptain ousts Schock as mayor |work=[[TribLocal]] |edition=Elgin |publisher=[[Tribune Interactive]] |accessdate=November 1, 2011 }}</ref>  Kaptain won the April 2011 election by receiving 54.35% of the mayoral votes, defeating incumbent [[Ed Schock]].<ref name="WinningStrategy">{{cite news |last=Jenco |first=Melissa |date=April 12, 2011 |url = http://triblocal.com/elgin/2011/04/12/knocking-on-doors-a-winning-strategy/ | title = Knocking on doors a winning strategy |work=[[TribLocal]] |edition=Elgin |publisher=[[Tribune Interactive]] |accessdate=November 1, 2011 }}</ref>

Kapt [[Elgin Area School District U46|School District U-46]]<nowiki/>i [[bachelor's degree|bachelor' degree]] from [[Bradley University]] in [[Peoria, Illinois]].<ref name="GiveChoice">{{cite news |last=Jenco |first=Melissa |date=March 23, 2011 |url= http://triblocal.com/elgin/2011/03/23/candidates-give-elgin-a-choice-for-mayor/ |title=Candidates give Elgin a choice for mayor |work=[[TribLocal]] |edition=Elgin |publisher=[[Tribune Interactive]] |accessdate=November 1, 2011 }}</ref>  He worked for 32 years for the [[Fox River (Illinois River tributary)|Fox River]] Water Reclamat, including as a chief chemist, before retiring from there.<ref name="KaptainOusts"/><ref name="GiveChoice"/> He was also the Elgin Community Networ executive director.<ref name="KaptainOusts"/>

He was on the Elgin [[city council]] from 2009 until becoming mayor.<ref name="GiveChoice"/>  After winning the election for mayor, Kaptain said that part of his approach would be to visit the homes of community members in Elgin to confer with them about city governance matters and to encourage higher voter turnout.<ref>{{cite web |last=Danahey |first=Mike |date=April 27, 2011 |url=http://couriernews.suntimes.com/news/5053934-418/kaptain-takes-the-helm.html |title=Kaptain sworn in as Elgin mayor |work=[[The Courier-News]] |location=Elgin, Illinois |publisher=[[Sun-Times Media Group]] |accessdate=November 1, 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120405083148/http://couriernews.suntimes.com/news/5053934-418/kaptain-takes-the-helm.html |archive-date=April 5, 2012 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
